**3. If you want to emphasize your own sense of achievement:**
> "I feel so accomplished when I overhear a German word I understand!"

**4. Casual/Informal:**
> "I love it when I catch a German word I actually know!"

**Summary of the nuance:**
In Norwegian, *"Hvor imponert jeg blir"* is a common way to express excitement or a sense of "wow." In English, if you say *"I am impressed,"* it can sometimes sound like you are impressed by the *word itself*. Using words like **"satisfying," "cool,"** or **"love it"** better captures the feeling of "I'm happy/proud that I understood that!"
